# Plotting Documentation

## [Back to Menu](../../README.md#documentation)

- Run the plot app with (assuming `build` is your build directory)

```bash
./build/bin/plot_app benchtools_results/\[2026-08-11\ 19:01:33\]_benchmarkresults.xml
```

- or use the compare arg to compare multiple benchmarks

```bash
./build/bin/plot_app --compare benchtools_results/\[2026-08-11\ 19:01:33\]_benchmarkresults.xml benchtools_results/\[2026-08-11\ 17:45:01\] ...
```
